requirements.statement: Every formal acceptance decision shall be associated with a corresponding governed CDE container status change.
When coordination sign-off or milestone approval occurs, the information container status shall be updated in the CDE to reflect the accepted state.
The CDE status of every container shall be traceable to a specific review record, sign-off event, or deviation approval.
Acceptance decisions recorded only in informal channels without a governed CDE status update shall not constitute governed acceptance.
If sign-off occurs outside the CDE, the Project BIM Manager or designated CDE lead shall execute the corresponding CDE status transition within 24 hours.
